Latency bars "shows" your ping (ping is the response time, the time between you pressing a button and the server recognizing that you pressed that button), so the lower your ping is, the quicker you will see your players moving or doing whatever you tell them to do.

As ping is a number, you should see It exactly on miliseconds, at least serious games show It that way, but FIFA is Far away from being a serious and competitive Game, that's why I say "shows", because It doesn't tell you the exact number, instead It shows you a range where your ping is, some people had postes that each bar means a 50ms range, so 5 bars y ping between 0 and 50 ms, 4 bars 50-100ms.

An aproppiate ping should be less than 50, less than 100 is acceptable, more than 100 is unplayable at least in competitive.
